title: UserConfig
description: The user config file. Every key is optional; a missing file means all defaults.

branches.description: Branch naming for new sessions; `forge.toml` can override each key.

default_agent.description: Agent profile ID used when neither the session nor the project names one.

BranchConfig.description:
Branch naming. Unset keys fall back to the next layer: `forge.toml`, then the user config,
then the defaults.

format.description:
Template for new branch names. `{type}` is the branch type and `{slug}` comes from the
session title. Default `{type}/{slug}`.

types.description:
Branch types a title may start with, as in `fix: retry loop`. The first is used when the
title names none. Default `["feat", "fix", "bug"]`.
